Healthclick artists have contributed to over 10,000 advertising campaigns across the world with medical illustrations and content. Our videographers, and content developers, have created over 5,000 major advertising campaigns for leading medical facilities, nonprofits, and private practices in the US. North American Seminars delivers Occupational Therapy and Physical Therapy Continuing Education to practitioners and organizations to facilitate better care and improved outcomes for patients.  healthclick is the website of North American Seminars, Inc. 
We provide continuing education for occupational and physical therapists. The content is not intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and does not constitute medical or other professional advice. Reliance on any information provided herein is solely at your own risk.
